post.summary:
REQ-APT-02 / UAT-APT-02: Patient check-in by receptionist.
Advances status to "waiting", stamps ArrivedAt, calculates sequential daily QueueNumber,
and triggers real-time notification to the doctor.

REQ-APT-02 & REQ-CLI-03: Doctor calls patient into exam room.
Advances status to "in_consultation", stamps ConsultationStartedAt, and optionally assigns room/chair.

REQ-APT-02: Doctor completes consultation.
Advances status to "completed" and stamps ConsultationEndedAt.

get.summary:
REQ-APT-02: Retrieves live waiting room queue for today.
Orders active patients: in_consultation first, then waiting by QueueNumber, then scheduled.

post.summary:
REQ-NOTIF-02: Sends manual or automated WhatsApp/SMS reminder for an appointment.
Updates LastReminderSentAt and increments ReminderCount.
REQ-NOTIF-02: Batch-sends reminders to all patients with upcoming appointments in the next 24 hours.

REQ-BIL-02: Records a split payment or additional installment for an existing invoice.
Recalculates PaidAmount and updates Status ('paid' if fully paid, 'partially_paid' if partial).

put.summary:
BR-RX-03 / BR-MED-01: Medical Record Immutability (Amendment Trail)
PUT does NOT overwrite original notes. It appends a permanent, timestamped amendment.

delete.summary: BR-RX-03 / BR-MED-01: Clinical encounter notes cannot be deleted from the database.

get.summary: REQ-COMM-01: Real-time Doctor Commission & Profit-Sharing Analytics

post.summary:
REQ-INV-02: Records an inward stock shipment / supplier purchase order delivery.
Increments inventory quantity, updates batch number, expiry date, supplier name, and unit cost.
REQ-PAT-03: Records patient digital consent signature (touchscreen or stylus capture).

put.summary:
BR-RX-02: Prescription Immutability & Audit Lock
Once finalized, editing medications or details is forbidden.

delete.summary: BR-RX-02: Deletion of finalized or archived prescriptions is strictly forbidden.

post.summary: BR-RX-02: Finalizes and digitally signs a prescription, permanently locking it.

BR-RX-02: Issues a superseding prescription when medication change is needed,
archiving the original with a mandatory recorded clinical justification.
REQ-SUB-01: Upgrade subscription tier or request quota seat expansion.
